title: STNFS at theta=455/1000, 1.25-SE descent relation input (63.98), boot (214,40,16,4), MIN_RELS=13, pad 1.61, sparse entries charged at the itemised 88, metered cap 2^119.518, BW 26x5: 2^122.230

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9); the exact modelled success is 0.3908847502 and its directed 4-decimal floor is 0.3908, above 0.39 (proof.md section 7). The relation-collection region is theta=455/1000 on the A^2=2^21 lattice (a uniform sub-region of the certified sampled pool), with exact certified lattice-count products at radius 976 of 0.974253611 (yield) and 1.024869209 (work), leaving the point-estimate relation margin at 0.3111 bits (above the model's 0.30 floor). The sampled relation-collection work carries a 9.09% canonical-work allowance equal to 3.50 incidence-inclusive standard errors (2.597%) of the total-work estimator over the 1806 contributing draws of the 20000-draw pool; it is a declared modeling margin for a fixed-domain quantity, not a per-challenge failure probability, and no sampling tail is charged against the success slack; the raw callgrind log behind the main-phase constants is included as measurements12.txt. Murphy alpha is charged at (5, 0.844) in both the main phase and the descent: the in-package computation over p <= 2000 gives 4.868096 and 0.545620, and 0.844 is the literature estimate carried by the accepted frontier package, above the computed values and the p <= 5000 value 0.4617. The two-log descent model is evaluated with the conservative relation-count input Pm.LOG2_RELS = floor(100*(log2_rels - 1.25*yield_se))/100 = 63.98, i.e. 1.25 pool standard errors (0.1268 bits each) below the run's log2_rels=64.1409; the experiment checks this inequality against the 1.25-SE lower value. Block-Wiedemann block sizes are m=26, n=5 (linear algebra 2^119.3827; each sparse entry is charged at its itemised 88 instructions = 33 la_mac.s + 4 block selection + 3 sign + 32 transfers + 16 finishing and row headers, DESCENT.md). The descent boot is (n1,nA,kA,R)=(214,189.83,16,4) with MIN_RELS=13 distinct relations; the expected two-log work is 2^118.6560157 and the meter is 2^119.518, so the success bound charges the Markov upper bound P(cap reached) <= E[W]/cap = 0.5501952893 (= 2^-0.861984 <= 2^-0.861), repeated ideals <= 2^-5.21 = 0.0270168 (2^30.05 special-q nodes) and boot failure 2*0.0159515860 = 0.0319031720 (psi^13 with psi = 0.72737; two boots). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.230 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.229525. No operation is dropped. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.230 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool and its theta=455/1000 uniform sub-region, exact certified lattice-count products at radius 976, the incidence-inclusive total-work standard error and the charged 3.50-SE allowance (1.0909), the ledger with the itemised 88-instruction linear-algebra entry and the descent at MIN_RELS=13 with the charged alpha_g=0.844, filtering, the block-Wiedemann parameters, the descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; derives the descent relation-count input 1.25 pool standard errors below the computed yield (floor(100*(64.1409 - 1.25*0.1268))/100 = 63.98) and checks it against that 1.25-SE lower value; prints total_log2W_full_ledger, work_se_total, modelled_success_floor4, the exact Markov/repeat/boot components and within_claim.
